description: Use this when the user asks for stock ideas or a list by a rule: stocks that meet an investor's published rules (rulebook: buffett (Warren Buffett), munger (Charlie Munger), graham (Benjamin Graham), fisher (Philip Fisher), lynch (Peter Lynch), greenblatt (Joel Greenblatt), smith (Terry Smith)), one of invest-like's published daily lists (list), or number filters such as P/E below 15, net margin above 20%, dividend yield above 3%, sales growth above 10%, with an optional sector, country and halal-only. Use exactly one of rulebook, list or filters. Lists come only from invest-like's data, never from memory. Results are screen results, not recommendations.

country.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. US, DE, GB

value.description: Percent metrics in percent (20 = 20%), market value in USD, P/E and net debt / EBITDA as plain numbers

halal_only.description: Only stocks that pass the halal screen

list.description: One of invest-like's published lists: strongest-moat, highest-roic, cheapest-pe, cheapest-peg, highest-fcf-yield, safest-dividend, lowest-debt, highest-gross-margin, highest-buyback-yield, halal-top-picks, magic-formula-top-30, consistent-compounders

rulebook.description: Stocks that meet this investor's published rules, e.g. 'graham' for 'stocks that pass Benjamin Graham's rules'

sort.description: For filters: the figure to sort by (default market value)

name: find_stocks
title: Find stocks by a rule
